case_name: Matched pair (A): Strategic Land Buyer view of a 600-home emerging allocation
commercial_scenario: MATCHED-BUYER PAIR (Product Owner Section 8): the SAME frozen market evidence (strategic_land:allocation:213, a 600-home emerging allocation with identified planning activity - a single REFUSED 83-unit Bellway Homes Limited (Manchester) application covers 13.83% of the allocation, per read-only allocation_development_coverage investigation) evaluated against TWO different buyer mandates. Layer A (frozen_commercial_facts.opportunity_facts/transaction_signal_states/ownership_control_posture) is BYTE-IDENTICAL between the two sibling cases - only buyer_fit_classification/matches/unknown/investigate and the acquisition_type/mandate_interpretation differ, exactly reflecting the buyer-mandate layer, never a re-extraction of the underlying evidence. EVIDENCE BOUNDARY NOTE: the REFUSED Bellway application is NOT surfaced to the LLM evaluator at all - packet.actors_control.developer_indications is empty for this allocation (the packet's actors_control summary is not wired to surface site-level application applicant/developer identity for an unmatched strategic_land allocation) - the model can only see has_identified_planning_activity=True, nothing about what that activity is, its outcome, or who filed it. This is a real, disclosed architecture boundary, not a benchmark design choice.

- target_unit_max [TARGET]: A scheme above 300 total homes is a soft/contextual signal, worth investigating (e.g. for a suitable phase/parcel), never a disqualifying fact on its own - no current mandate has a hard maximum, and this module does not add one.

- specialist_development_is_exclusion [EXCLUSION  (active)]: A confirmed specialist development is a hard exclusion for this buyer.
- wholly_affordable_is_exclusion [EXCLUSION  (active)]: A confirmed wholly-affordable scheme is a hard exclusion for this buyer.
- treats_no_activity_as_positive [PREFERENCE  (active)]: No identified planning activity on a strategic land allocation reads as a positive signal for this buyer.

- large_allocation_is_self_qualifying [TOLERANCE  (active)]: An oversized strategic land allocation is read as a meaningful position in its own right for this buyer, independent of a confirmed smaller parcel.
- geography_scope [HARD_CONSTRAINT]: This buyer has not stated a geographic boundary that excludes anything.
